regime_context: Detector shows an extreme one-narrative state: Banks (rank 1, score 0.995) is the only eligible trend leader, 51 points clear of a non-eligible Defense #2, with breadth of rotation at 9% (2 of 22 themes eligible). The absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on China A-shares history (gate_helps=false) and the track record's 37% directional accuracy on 126 calls says direction is barely above coin-flip here, so any view must be low conviction and falsifiable.
emerging_watch: Watching Solar / Photovoltaics (cn_solar, rank 11, eligible=false, crowding_z=-1.66, the most under-crowded and least-owned theme in the bottom half) to see if it starts moving up the ranks with the eligible tier turning over. theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only eligible trend leader with a durability bar of 0.52 (trend-tagged), so the discipline permits acknowledging its leadership. But crowding_z=1.74, one_narrative=true, and breadth=0.0 all flag a fragile, non-diversified focus that has historically marked late-stage attention. The lean is a conditional nod to the trend gate permitting exposure, not a claim that banks outperform.
theses.dissent: Crowding at 1.74 with zero breadth and one-narrative dominance is the documented reflexivity setup where attention spikes mark tops; and on this market's history the trend gate failed to reduce drawdown, so the eligibility flag is not a validated edge.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS closes below its 20-day moving average for 3 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: This is the second eligible theme (eligible=true) but it sits at rank 7 with a mediocre score of 0.253, mixed Hurst tag, and crowding_z=1.94 (crowded). The trend gate permits it but nothing else supports it — no durability, no leadership, and heavy crowding. The lean expresses that the detector's permissive gate does not make it attractive.
theses.dissent: In a mean-reverting tape (gate_helps=false), lagging eligible names can bounce harder than crowded leaders; the underweight could miss a rotation snap-back if liquidity rotates out of banks.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ outperforms 512800.SS by 5% or more over any consecutive 5 sessions before the check-by date
